key_highlights: Mining and energy rebound drives ASX higher, supported by active gold sector exploration and firm commodity pricing.
Higher-than-expected inflation data maintains aggressive upward pressure on RBA cash rate expectations.
Household mortgage stress and negative equity concerns escalate amid prominent warnings of domestic recession.
Parliament passes domestic gas reservation scheme to rein in energy costs, impacting domestic gas producers.
Flight Centre investigates mass cyber breach affecting a significant volume of customer data.

sectors.trend: Resources lead market recovery supported by strong exploration activity across WA, SA, and NSW gold deposits.
sectors.implications: Favourable momentum for ASX gold and diversified miners; junior explorers gain valuation support.

sectors.trend: Domestic gas reservation legislation clears parliament while global geopolitical tensions persist.
sectors.implications: Potential margin compression for domestic East Coast gas producers; relief for energy-intensive industrial users.

sectors.trend: Accelerating mortgage stress, rising negative equity, and housing price declines across capital cities.
sectors.implications: Heightened credit impairment risks and bad debt provisioning headwind for major retail banks.

sectors.trend: Major corporate cyber breach at Flight Centre paired with retailer insolvency warnings and recessionary sentiment.
sectors.implications: Increased earnings downside, cyber remediation costs, and depressed discretionary household spending.

sectors.trend: Developer collapses and apartment deposit losses indicate stress in residential construction.
sectors.implications: Dampened demand for residential property assets and increased counterparty default risks.

key_themes: Persistent inflation prolonging restrictive RBA monetary policy
Two-speed market: resource sector resilience versus domestic consumer and mortgage stress
Heightened corporate vulnerabilities across cybersecurity and residential construction

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Persistent Inflation and RBA Rate Hikes
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight rate-sensitive consumer discretionary and real estate; maintain liquidity in cash equivalents.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Mortgage Delinquencies and Banking Credit Losses
risk_assessment.mitigation: Screen banking exposures for conservative loan-to-value ratios and high capital adequacy buffers.
Focus on diversified energy producers with substantial uncontracted export LNG exposure.
Avoid entities with pending major data breaches; prioritize companies with audited security frameworks.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Gold Producers and Resource Majors
opportunities.rationale: Gold exploration updates and resource rebound offer inflation and currency hedging benefits.

opportunities.recommendation: Capitalise on Energy and Defensive Healthcare
opportunities.rationale: Stable operational cash flows and pricing power amid macro uncertainty.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim Travel and Discretionary Retail Exposures
defensive_moves.rationale: Cyber risk at Flight Centre and shrinking household discretionary income present acute downside.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge Domestic Banking and Residential Construction Exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Rising negative equity and mortgage arrears elevate bad debt risks for domestic retail lenders.

market_outlook.short_term: Range-bound ASX 200 (^AXJO) trading as resource gains balance consumer weakness and sticky inflation headwinds.
market_outlook.long_term: Macro slowdown and rate pressures favour quality balance sheets, gold miners, and global commodity exporters.
key_catalysts: Upcoming RBA Board monetary policy meeting and cash rate guidance
Official quarterly CPI print and trimmed mean inflation reads
Forensic disclosure and regulatory response to Flight Centre's cyber incident
Legislative rollout and compliance guidelines for the gas reservation scheme
watch_list: AUD/USD and commodity benchmarks (gold, iron ore, Brent crude)
CoreLogic capital city home value index and mortgage arrears data
ASX consumer discretionary retail trading updates
